about: START-TAINT part 1 (runtime/taintCfg.js): each branch's join and the write set of everything either arm may write. Each rule must be able to fail.

mutants.mutant: a conditional branch's jump target is dropped (only the fall-through arm is walked)
the walk runs through the join (writes after the branch leak into its set)
mutants.from: if (seen.has(pc) || pc === join || pc === branch) continue
mutants.expectRed: nothing at or after the join

mutants.mutant: a var initialiser (JUMP_IF_INIT) is not a branch
a call site's persist base is not applied
mutants.from: for (const x of d.persist) out.persist.add(pb + x)

mutants.mutant: a skipped call site's history hand-off cells are left out
mutants.from: for (let k = 0; k < (f.historyCount || 0); k += 1) out.held.add((site.historyBase || 0) + k)
mutants.to: for (let k = 0; k < 0; k += 1) out.held.add((site.historyBase || 0) + k)

mutants.mutant: nested call sites are not folded in
mutants.from: for (const kind of WRITE_KINDS) if (kind !== 'locals') for (const x of inner[kind]) out[kind].add(x)
mutants.to: for (const kind of []) if (kind !== 'locals') for (const x of inner[kind]) out[kind].add(x)
